notes.title: REWORKED FLASHLIGHT & SPRAY UPDATE
notes.notes:
Additions

Flashlight


-Reworked the flashlight logic and changed its UI

-Added flashlight in hand to CO-OP

-Increased time before flashlight overheating

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620869/5594ea3dc03d6574faa58f98e3f982a04c85163b.png"]
Spray


-Reduced time between spray uses

-Now you can change a spray image to your own in pause menu


[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620869/4cf8cf705c655333a61629e6e53aefc557af4a5a.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620869/174bea3fad651767fa304b6e44bd538a3f7fab72.png"][/carousel]Other

-Fixed a bug that caused the host to not display correctly in the pause menu





Thank you all for your support. 

Stay tune for more

notes.title: CO-OP LOBBY + SUMMER EVENT UPDATE
notes.notes:
NEW CO-OP LOBBY UPDATE + SUMMER EVENT HAS ARRIVED!

Additions


-Added two new skins and new dance emote 

the first skin and emote can be purchased from a trader on Level 1247

the second skin can be earned in a new mini-game

-Updated the CO-OP lobby to create a summer mood ː2016watermelonː

-Expanded CO-OP lobby map with new interactions

-A 2 new mini-games has been added!


[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620869/b26d3eab56dd1f8052e88ba6462c73a8c1c44ca2.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620869/526a8e5d4e78be81b010414a2f72f7e0186c52e1.png"][/carousel]

[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620869/431d14d77b0c8682110232f27d80f575e4671656.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620869/794d4cd43ef31b1f5b0f1b76571b12b5ea847669.png"][/carousel]

Bug Fixes


-Fixed a bug where FoV settings were reset to default when traveling to any CO-OP level

-Fixed a bug with the basketball game where the ball would get stuck in the wall when pulling the lever

-Fixed a bug that could cause the jump animation to loop



In the next update there will be a new CO-OP level that can be completed alone.

This level will be the last one, after this update I will be improving features that are already in the game and after that the game will move from early access to full release.



Thank you all for your support. 

Stay tune for more



My Discord server: https://discord.com/invite/hyUpPPG8X6

notes.title: Small Update (Controls change, Level 0 and Level 43 improvements, bug fixes)
notes.notes:
This update features new Controls change menu, Level 0 and Level 43 improvements + bug fixes


Additions and changes:
-Added control menu!
-Added new mobs on Levels 0 and 43.
-Added spectate mode (similar to Level 232.2) after player's dies from a mob on Levels 0 and 43
-Changed notes logic on Levels 0 and 43
-Changed level selection widget in CO-OP
-Changed ambient sound on singleplayer Level 9
-Slightly changed the singleplayer menu
-Improved mob logic on Levels 0 and 43
-Improved graphics and performance on level 43

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620869/ecc0968d0d25cdae8e1dd08bf3c5f0529ab68826.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620869/4e65c911588f8bb749ffaed8220c0cd7617b260d.png

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed a bug on Level 43 where mobs could teleport or run at you while you were looking at them, also reduced mob shaking.
-Fixed a bug with outfit appearance on Levels 0 and 43.
-Fixed a bug with entities on Levels 0 and 43 where after mob catches player, the player's screen could freeze with the face of the mob.
-Fixed a few minor bugs


Next update will be fixing bugs and adding more stuff to the game!


Thank you all for your support.
Stay tune for more



My Discord server: https://discord.gg/8enqq3EV

notes.title: CHRISTMAS UPDATE HAS ARRIVED + CHANGES ON LEVEL 0
notes.notes:
Christmas update is here + some changes in CO-OP Level 0


Additions

-The CO-OP lobby now has Christmas decor and a new small location
-New locations have been added to CO-OP Level 0 for exploration
-Added a Christmas hat for all players
-Camera Shake option added


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620869/7d4e46a4af241b5b90d4bec19550b4143557e64d.png


Bug Fixes

-Fixed a bug that could cause the jump animation to get stuck
-Fixed some collisions
-Corrected the name on tape 1 and 2 on Level 0


You can get a Christmas scanner skin in the CO-OP lobby!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620869/e3d210043b270fddc79e12ee9ffc5518b7a26a1c.png


All you have to do is collect all the Christmas gifts in the CO-OP lobby, after that you can enter the staircase doors, where you'll find a gift that will give you a scanner skin.



Merry Christmas to all of you and thank you for your support!



Stay tune for more.


My Discord server: https://discord.gg/v89cANSsPR
